items.title: MemT-1.0: Towards Memory-Native Evolution
items.summary: Memory-native evolution requires making memory an intrinsic capability of foundation models, enabling them to continuously accumulate and utilize information. To this end, we introduce MemT-1.0, a new architecture of memory foundation models that internalize memory as part of model computation. items.title: Learning from Fleet Experience: A Collective Learning Paradigm for Robots
items.summary: Experience generated during deployment offers an opportunity for robots to improve policy reliability through learning from their own executions. items.summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made rapid progress on visual reasoning, yet many tasks require evidence that is difficult to obtain through internal reasoning alone: our controlled study on 22 benchmarks shows that simply increasing the inference budget of the base model yields only modest gains. items.title: EgoXperience: Learning World-Grounded Egocentric Representations from Human Experience
items.summary: Reconstructing human activity from egocentric video requires more than recovering individual 3D components: the observer's motion, surrounding geometry, and hand-object interactions must fit together in a consistent world. items.summary: Human egocentric experience offers a rich foundation for learning how the world is organized and how it changes through interaction. items.title: ScaleNav: Scalable Internet Video Pretraining for Language-Conditioned Local Navigation
items.summary: We study language-conditioned local navigation, where a robot must navigate to a text-specified target visible in its initial observation and stop at the described location. items.summary: Can large language model (LLM) agents deliver expert-level operations research (OR) solutions directly from original client materials, without prior expert reformulation? items.summary: AI coworkers must coordinate tools, communicate across turns, and act on changing workspace state while respecting workflow constraints. items.title: RoboValue: A Fine-Grained Sim-and-Real Benchmark for Unified Evaluation of Robotic Value Models
items.summary: Robotic value models assess task execution from visual observations and instructions, providing feedback for policy learning and execution monitoring. items.summary: Procedural generation plays a key role in synthetic data creation and game development, offering greater controllability, editability, and diversity than static mesh representations. items.summary: Memory has become integral to the LLM agent ecosystem, supporting information retention and reuse across interactions. items.summary: Adapting existing manga into coherent animation that stays faithful to the source is a valuable yet challenging task. items.title: AffordanceWAM: Affordance-Aware Joint World-Action Modeling for Robot Manipulation
items.summary: Generalizable robot manipulation requires predicting how a scene will evolve, identifying where interactions are feasible, and determining how to act. items.title: AdaExploreBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Proactive Exploration and Test-time Adaptation in Evolving Environments
items.summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in unfamiliar and evolving environments, requiring them to proactively explore, understand, and adapt to environmental dynamics. items.summary: Video overlay removal aims to recover scenes obscured by subtitles, titles, and logos while preserving surrounding content. items.summary: Harness development plays a crucial role in building capable AI agents. Recent approaches improve harnesses through recursive self-improvement (RSI), but their performance gains often come with higher execution costs.
